'''Michael Lee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 New Jersey State Championship]] on 20 May 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Michael Dalton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2335">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-nj-states-may-20thd2335/ nj-states-may-20th], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 20 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-nj-states-may-20thd2335/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
